subject: lantern-shell tortoise automaton
pose: 三分之二侧面，一足前移
art_direction: 龟偶甲壳是带孔青铜灯罩但不发强光，红陶四足与小木头，侧面稳稳迈步。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Invent a tortoise automaton with a perforated bronze shell shaped like a low lantern dome. The shell contains a faint warm reflection, not a bright lamp. Four terracotta feet and a small carved-wood head emerge beneath it, with one foot moved forward. Give the face a calm satisfied mouth and small engraved eyes. Show patina around the shell holes and smooth wear on the clay feet. Use a deep green-gray background with controlled side light, keeping the object compact and excluding a scenic setting or exposed gears everywhere. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
